text: Acceptance 14: a delayed send inserts its reply into whichever thread is currently open. Deferred-response DOM reproduction: send in thread 90, switch to 91, then complete the POST; output is current root 91, reply roots [null,90], and the isolation assertion fails. Capture the conversation and thread before awaiting; update the panel only if both still match, with a regression test for switching or closing threads during sends.
